[[File:Snape grass detail.png|left|100px]]
'''Snape grass''' is a [[Herblore]] [[Herblore secondaries|secondary ingredient]] that can be grown through the [[Farming]] [[Skills|skill]] at level 61 with [[snape grass seed]]s. 8 snape grass are needed to protect growing [[Potato cactus (plant)|potato cactus]].

It is used to make [[prayer potion]]s and [[fishing potion]]s. It is also used when making the [[hangover cure]] [[Quests|quest]] item. When placed in a [[Compost Bin|compost bin]], snape grass will create [[supercompost]].

Farming [[Snape grass plant|snape grass]] gives a decent amount of [[experience]] and thus is a great way for players (especially [[Ironman Mode|ironmen]]) to train the skill.

==Uses in quests==
* [[Plague City]]: 1 × snape grass to make [[hangover cure]]
* [[Fairytale I - Growing Pains]]: possible item from a list to obtain [[magic secateurs]].
* [[Skippy and the Mogres]]: 1 × snape grass to make hangover cure

==Trivia==
* Snape grass appears to be based on some kind of {{WP|psammophile|psammophilic}} (sand-loving) beach grass, such as ''{{WP|Leymus arenarius}}'' or ''{{WP|Ammophila (plant)|Ammophila}}'', as snape grass is a spiky grass only found in the wild near coastlines.
* According to the book ''[[Gielinor's flora - allotments]]'', "Snape grass has a subtle fruity flavour and is often used in teas. When crushed, the leaves emit a fruit smell which can be used to repel some insects, but interestingly has been known to attract bees." In addition, the leaves change colour from green to red during changing autumn temperatures, but this does not occur in-game.
